Subject: Need help with a tenancy eviction case

Hello, my name is Varun Hegde. I am a 59-year-old railway employee living in Nashik. I have a tenancy problem with Madhuri Kurian involving ₹2,55,000 in rent, and the landlord is trying to evict the tenant after a rent increase was refused. My case number is R.C.S. No. 2056/2020 in the Nashik District Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 07404299127 or email varun.hegde@example.in.
